entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-11-17
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Exhaustiveness check malfunction for generic closed class with nested case types #86515
  • VB Simplifier removes a cast in an object creation argument that selects the constructor overload #86513
  • VB Simplifier removes As clause of a local/For/For Each variable even when the name then binds to a different symbol #86512
  • It looks like significance of `allowRefOmittedArguments` and `expanded` in `HasCollectionExpressionApplicableAddMethod` isn't observed by tests #86509
    Backlog

Closed

  • Runtime async: CS4007 is not reported for Span<T>/ref struct locals used across await; code compiles and silently misbehaves #86469
    18.14

PullRequests

Created

  • Do not flow the Visual Studio SDK from ExternalAccess #86522
    Area-IDE
  • Display project load diagnostics in the problems list #86521
    Area-Infrastructure, VSCode
  • Test semantic tokens for Razor component aliases #86519
    Area-Razor
  • Support using aliases for component binding in the Razor compiler #86518
    Area-Razor
  • Fix dead csharplang proposal links in feature docs #86517
    Community
  • Reuse BoundValueForNullableAnalysis instances to avoid infinite expansion of placeholder slots while analyzing loop constructs #86516
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Unions
  • Use the formatting options' newline when inserting suppression pragmas #86514
    Area-IDE, Community, VSCode
  • Fail if cache purging cannot be completed #86511
    Area-Infrastructure, Feature - Caching Compiler
  • Add .NET 11 reference assembly presets to analyzer testing #86510
    Area-Infrastructure, Community, Needs API Review

Merged

  • Fix repository name in formatting documentation #86508
    Next
  • Report CS4007 for restricted types used across await with runtime async #86486
    Area-Compilers, Community, Next

Updated

  • Initial implementation of type parameter inference from constraints #86497
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Type Inference from Constraints
  • Remove project-system InternalsVisibleTo #86194
    Area-IDE
  • Fix Razor generic component parameters when there are multiple matches #86483
    Area-Razor
  • Localized file check-in by OneLocBuild Task: Build definition ID 327: Build ID 3138931 #86046
    Area-Razor
  • Replace copied hashing implementations #86377
    VSCode, Area-Razor
  • Migrate tests to xUnit v3 #85776
    VSCode, Area-Razor
  • Infer the target's nullability for 'ref var' locals #86478
    Area-Compilers, Community
  • Stop scanning preceding siblings in SyntaxNavigator.GetNextToken/GetPreviousToken #86352
    Area-Compilers, Community
  • Add a fixall in document LSP code action #86229
    Area-IDE, VSCode
  • Improve classification of file-based app directives #86493
    Area-IDE, VSCode, Feature - Run File
  • Fix Generate Constructor crash when inspecting properties in referenced projects #86021
    Area-IDE, VSCode
